findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment: 3-305.11: (A) Observed cup used as scoop in container of sugar. Cup was removed from sugar.  FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.
